objective: Find five new, independently useful FLINT optimizations ready for maintainer review, supported by correctness tests, reproducible benchmarks, and documented applicability.

policy.timing: Resident libraries; equal work; alternating ABBA/BAAB; CPU and wall clocks; unchanged-source and same-function controls; no concurrent campaign computation.
policy.correctness: Independent references and relevant upstream tests; cover aliases, boundaries, fallback paths, and applicable thread counts. Preserve rigorous numerical contracts.
policy.evidence: Freeze candidate source, binaries, workloads and plans before confirmation; retain raw samples and rejected candidates. Do not overwrite historical evidence.
policy.portability: Prefer portable source changes. Report architecture-specific paths and untested platforms explicitly.
policy.combined_validation: Check interactions and performance of the retained patch series before completion.
